# Bay Glass

> Bay Glass is a glass and glazing specialist based at 40 Klinac Lane, Waipapa
> 0230, serving Kerikeri, the Bay of Islands and wider Northland, New Zealand.
> Family-run, with its own installation team and a 24-hour emergency glazing
> callout across Northland. Rated 4.9 from 57 Google reviews.

## Services

- [Glass & glazing](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/glass-glazing/): broken window and glass replacement, new glazing for builds and renovations, mirrors cut to fit, 24-hour emergency board-ups.
- [Retrofit double glazing](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/retrofit-double-glazing/): double glazing fitted into existing aluminium or timber joinery, no reframing.
- [Coloured glass splashbacks](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/splashbacks/): toughened coloured, clear or printed glass splashbacks, measured and cut to fit.
- [Frameless glass showers](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/glass-showers/): frameless and semi-frameless shower enclosures, measured on site.
- [Balustrades & pool fences](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/balustrades-pool-fences/): glass and aluminium balustrades, handrails and pool fencing built to the NZ Building Code.
- [Security & insect screens](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/security-insect-screens/): security and insect screens fitted to existing doors and windows.
- [Outdoor room & louvre roofs](https://bayglass.co.nz/services/outdoor-room-louvre-roofs/): adjustable louvre roofs and outdoor room systems, Bask products supplied and installed.
